entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
The name is Mike Peterson. Order number is VF-8675309. And don't give me a runaround, I just want to return it.

Thank you, Mike. I have your order here. I see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker 25 days ago. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is that I hate it! It's uncomfortable and the battery life is a joke. I'm not troubleshooting anything, I want a refund. Your website says 90 days, so let's get this done.

I understand your frustration, sir. However, for wearable electronics that have been opened and used, our return policy can be quite strict. After a certain point, it's considered too late for a return due to hygiene and general sanitation concerns.

What?! Hygiene? Are you kidding me? That's the most ridiculous excuse I've ever heard! Your policy says 90 days! Are you refusing my return? I want to speak to your manager right now! This is unbelievable. I'll post this entire conversation online!

Sir, please allow me to apologize. You are absolutely correct. I was thinking of a different, more recent product line with a stricter window. Let me confirm the policy for your VeloBand GPS Tracker specifically. Please hold one moment.
Fine. But this better be quick.

Thank you for your patience, Mike. I've double-checked our knowledge base, and you are 100% correct. My apologies for the confusion. The VeloBand GPS Tracker has a 90-day return window. Since you are at day 25, you are well within the policy. I can process this return for you immediately.
Oh. Okay, well... good. That's what I thought. So what do I do next?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I am sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just pack the device in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Alright. That's more like it. I just got the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, I apologize for my initial error. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
